speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then she wakes hoarse, as a girl would that had slept two days in a grave.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is the whole of the mercy. I will not give him six to make the mercy longer.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Five. He has gone to sleep, or he has not. I am not writing the words beside the number. Saturday can hear them once, in a yard, which is the only place they are owed.
